snippet.title: PAC-MAN 1983 DOS PC
snippet.description:
PAC-MAN 1983 Gameplay video.

Official Pac-Man released from Atarisoft for the PC. I somewhat prefer the unofficial clone, PC-Man from 1yr prior. Nonetheless this is a little different. The ghosts can turn back if you follow too closely which is a more challenging and good gameplay feature of this maze arcade classic.
